content: Inspecting source tree, package scripts, and current tool registration to understand how the active note feature is implemented before changing code.

Current `get_active_note` implementation in `src/tools/obsidianTools.ts` uses `app.workspace.getActiveViewOfType(MarkdownView)` and `view.editor.getSelection()`. This likely fails when the Pi chat view has focus because the active workspace view is not a MarkdownView.

observation: `createObsidianTools` registers vault tools plus `get_active_note`; the active note tool currently depends on `app.workspace.getActiveViewOfType(MarkdownView)` and throws when the active leaf is not a MarkdownView.
Existing tests cover task tools only; Obsidian module is mocked with MarkdownView/TFile/TFolder classes, so active/open note behavior can be covered with lightweight fake App/workspace objects.
Agent tools are created at initialization and refreshed via `refreshConfiguration`; adding a tool to `createObsidianTools` exposes it to new and refreshed agent state.
Validation commands are `npm test` for Vitest and `npm run build` for TypeScript/esbuild.

content: Finished initial project/tool research. Next step is checking Obsidian types to choose the correct APIs for active file and open tabs.
Searching the installed `obsidian` type definitions for Workspace active file/view and leaf/tab APIs.

observation: `Workspace.getActiveFile(): TFile | null` is the public API for this use case: it returns the file for the current FileView, otherwise the most recently active file.

`Workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(root?: WorkspaceParent)` is documented as useful for interacting with the main-root leaf while a sidebar leaf is active; this helps retrieve a Markdown editor/selection when Pi chat has focus.

`Workspace.getLeavesOfType(viewType: string)` and `WorkspaceLeaf.getViewState()` are public APIs for enumerating open leaves. Deferred background leaves may not have `MarkdownView`, so the view state's `state.file` should be used for open Markdown tabs when available.

`Workspace.iterateRootLeaves` only covers the main workspace area, while `iterateAllLeaves` includes main, popout, and sidebar leaves. `getLeavesOfType("markdown")` is the simplest public API for open Markdown note leaves.

`MarkdownFileInfo` exposes `file` and optional `editor`; `MarkdownView` implements it and exposes `editor`, so selection can be read from `MarkdownFileInfo.editor?.getSelection()` when the matching editor is loaded.

content: Finished Obsidian API/type research. The fix should switch active note path resolution to `workspace.getActiveFile()` and use workspace leaves/view state for the new open-notes tool.
